findings.subject: Enel December 2024 agency agreement
findings.finding: The issuer archive supplied the 20 December 2024 execution-version agency agreement. Page 5 identifies both Enel issuers and applies the agreement to new notes issued after its date, subject to the older-series consolidation exception. This matches the programme date named in the retained February 2025 final terms. Page 95 contains maturity redemption by reference to the applicable final terms; page 44 retains the amendment conditions.
findings.remaining: Retrieval and a targeted date/clause correspondence review are complete. Signed execution, series-specific amendments, all 187 pages' legal effect and the full contract chain are not independently established; the original qualified classification is not promoted to complete legal clearance.

each Note will be redeemed by the Issuer at its Final Redemption Amount specified in, or determined in the manner specified in, the applicable Final Terms
Any modification made under Clause 29.1.1 or 29.1.2 shall be binding on the Noteholders and the Couponholders

findings.subject: Enel guarantee and covenant
findings.finding: The matching dated guarantee and Enel Finance International covenant are retained. Guarantee clause 2.1 promises due payment with the clause 2.1(d) 120% principal/interest cap; clause 2.2 gives unsecured unsubordinated status. Covenant clause 1 supplies direct rights when a global note becomes void, subject to holder and clearing-system conditions.
findings.remaining: Execution-version headings do not prove signed execution: the retained covenant's signature block is blank. No actual holder entitlement, applicable later amendment, enforcement outcome or complete governing-law analysis is established.

evidence.quote: THIS DEED OF GUARANTEE is made on 20 December 2024

ENEL as principal obligor hereby unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees by way of deed poll to each Beneficiary the due and punctual payment of all amounts due from time to time to such Beneficiary by the Issuer
120 per cent. of the aggregate principal amount of any Tranche of the Notes
If any Global Note becomes void in accordance with its terms, the Issuer covenants with each Relevant Account Holder

findings.subject: BASF 2032 source dependency and controlling language
findings.finding: The final terms identify XS2595418596 but expressly require the September 2022 programme and February 2023 supplement. The selected conditions use German as controlling language. The reader correctly abstains on the missing operative documents.
findings.remaining: Obtain the exact dated base and supplement, inspect selected Option I and reconcile the controlling German terms. A different current programme cannot fill this gap.

findings.subject: LVMH 2029 repayment evidence and remaining abstention
findings.finding: The matching base, three supplements and final terms are retained. Item 22 equates EUR100,000 redemption with EUR100,000 denomination. Two other supposed cash witnesses were unsupported coupon/definition matches; failing counterexamples reproduced the defect and the repaired matcher removed them. Five coupon-forfeiture/partial-redemption clauses remain unresolved by the bounded reader.
findings.remaining: The result remains unresolved. A new reviewed repair must distinguish coupon rights and principal reduced through cash payment, including mixed-clause counterexamples. All four selected cases are exposed after the repair; the preserved original frozen challenge does not establish population accuracy.

findings.subject: BBVA Series 15 conversion conditions
findings.finding: Condition 6.1 requires conversion into ordinary/Common Shares after the defined CET1 trigger, without holder approval. The separate capital-reduction mechanism in condition 6.2 allows a timely holder election against conversion; the accepted witnesses rely on 6.1.
findings.remaining: The qualified positive establishes a conditional feature in the offering circular. No actual trigger, complete agency agreement, current Spanish-law analysis, share quantity or investor permission is established.

evidence.quote: irrevocably and mandatorily (and without any requirement for the consent or approval of Holders) convert all the Preferred Securities into Common Shares
each Holder will have the right to elect that its Preferred Securities shall not be converted in accordance with this Condition 6.2

findings.subject: SEB 2024 principal extinguishment and share settlement
findings.finding: Condition 5A.01 converts the notes automatically after the defined trigger. Condition 5A.02 reduces principal to zero while preserving conversion-share delivery rights. The qualified positive concerns this contractual principal mechanism; share delivery or sale proceeds may retain value.
findings.remaining: Zero principal does not mean zero economic recovery. Actual trigger determinations, share-price/rounding inputs, fiscal agency agreements, delivery notices and Swedish-law conditions remain unverified.

evidence.quote: the principal amount of the Notes will be permanently reduced to zero and, accordingly, shall equal zero at all times thereafter
the Bank’s only remaining obligation under the Notes shall be an obligation to deliver Conversion Shares to the Settlement Shares Depositary

findings.subject: Unilever public agreement recovery
findings.finding: The issuer programme route returned HTTP 403. This is failed retrieval evidence, not evidence that the required agreement does not exist.
findings.remaining: Applicable executed agreements, guarantees and amendments remain open; the earlier retained offering documents do not establish a complete contract set.

findings.subject: Lloyds primary filing recovery
findings.finding: The SEC primary-filing request returned HTTP 403. The existing secondary filing copy remains qualified.
findings.remaining: Obtain and compare the original dated filing and applicable executed agreements. A failed request neither invalidates nor authenticates the secondary copy.

findings.subject: Current HKMA IC-1 authority
findings.finding: The known official PDF route returns HTTP 302 to brdr.hkma.gov.hk. That host is outside this campaign's frozen public-host policy, so its content was not retrieved.
findings.remaining: Review the exact redirected host in a new acquisition protocol and inspect the dated current text with other applicable authority. This campaign does not establish complete or current legal coverage.
